{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}
{-# LANGUAGE BangPatterns #-}
module Codec.Serialize.Core where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Word
import Data.Bits
import GHC.Generics
import Data.IORef

-- Feature flags for serialization behavior
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffEnableCompression :: Bool
  , ffEnableDedup :: Bool
  , ffMaxDepth :: Int
  , ffHashBuckets :: Int
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

defaultFlags :: FeatureFlags
defaultFlags = FeatureFlags True True 64 65536

-- Internal hash table for deduplication during deserialization
type DedupTable = Map.Map Word32 BL.ByteString

-- Hash function for dedup keys - strict evaluation with bang patterns
hashKey :: BL.ByteString -> Int -> Word32
hashKey bs buckets =
  let !bytes = BL.unpack (BL.take 1024 bs)  -- Cap input to hash function
      !h = foldl' (\!acc b -> acc * 31 + fromIntegral b) 0 bytes
  in h `mod` (fromIntegral (max 65536 buckets))
  where
    foldl' f !z [] = z
    foldl' f !z (x:xs) = let !z' = f z x in foldl' f z' xs

-- Serialization node types
data SerNode
  = SAtom BL.ByteString
  | SList [SerNode]
  | SRef Word32
  deriving (Show)

-- Decode a varint from bytestring
decodeVarint :: BL.ByteString -> (Word32, BL.ByteString)
decodeVarint bs = go 0 0 bs
  where
    go !acc !shift remaining
      | BL.null remaining = (acc, remaining)
      | shift > 28 = (acc, remaining)  -- Prevent overflow from malicious varints
      | otherwise =
          let b = BL.head remaining
              rest = BL.tail remaining
              val = fromIntegral (b .&. 0x7F)
              !acc' = acc .|. (val `shiftL` shift)
          in if b .&. 0x80 == 0
             then (acc', rest)
             else go acc' (shift + 7) rest

-- Core deserialization with dedup table
deserializeNode :: FeatureFlags -> DedupTable -> BL.ByteString -> Int -> Int -> (SerNode, DedupTable, BL.ByteString)
deserializeNode flags table input depth totalNodes
  | depth > ffMaxDepth flags = (SAtom "", table, input)
  | totalNodes > 10000 = (SAtom "", table, input)  -- Cap total nodes
  | BL.null input = (SAtom "", table, input)
  | otherwise =
      let tag = BL.head input
          rest = BL.tail input
      in case tag of
        0x01 -> -- Atom
          let (!len, rest') = decodeVarint rest
              safeLen = min len 65536  -- Cap atom size
              (!payload, rest'') = BL.splitAt (fromIntegral safeLen) rest'
              !key = hashKey payload (ffHashBuckets flags)
              !table' = if ffEnableDedup flags && Map.size table < 4096
                        then Map.insert key payload table
                        else table
          in (SAtom payload, table', rest'')
        0x02 -> -- List
          let (!count, rest') = decodeVarint rest
              safeCount = min (fromIntegral count) 1000  -- Cap list size
          in deserializeList flags table rest' safeCount depth 0 []
        0x03 -> -- Back-reference (dedup)
          let (!ref, rest') = decodeVarint rest
              resolved = case Map.lookup ref table of
                           Just v -> SAtom v
                           Nothing -> SAtom ""
          in (resolved, table, rest')
        _ -> (SAtom "", table, rest)

deserializeList :: FeatureFlags -> DedupTable -> BL.ByteString -> Int -> Int -> Int -> [SerNode] -> (SerNode, DedupTable, BL.ByteString)
deserializeList flags table input 0 _ _ acc = (SList (reverse acc), table, input)
deserializeList flags table input count depth totalNodes acc =
  let (!node, !table', rest) = deserializeNode flags table input (depth + 1) (totalNodes + 1)
  in deserializeList flags table' rest (count - 1) depth (totalNodes + 1) (node : acc)

-- Public API: deserialize with configurable flags
deserialize :: FeatureFlags -> BL.ByteString -> SerNode
deserialize flags input =
  let safeFlags = flags { ffHashBuckets = max 65536 (ffHashBuckets flags) }
      (!node, _, _) = deserializeNode safeFlags Map.empty input 0 0
  in node

-- Batch deserialization endpoint
deserializeBatch :: FeatureFlags -> [BL.ByteString] -> [SerNode]
deserializeBatch flags inputs =
  let safeInputs = take 100 inputs  -- Cap batch size
  in map (deserialize flags) safeInputs

-- Configuration loader
loadFlags :: IO FeatureFlags
loadFlags = return defaultFlags

main :: IO ()
main = do
  flags <- loadFlags
  let input = BL.pack [0x01, 0x03, 0x41, 0x42, 0x43]  -- Simple atom "ABC"
  let result = deserialize flags input
  print result
